summary.zh: 校园日程决定一天内的时间段流转，也决定普通学生与未集合组织成员的自动分布。
summary.en: The school day controls time-block progression and the routine movement of normal students and dispersed organization members.

items.zh: 现实 5 分钟约等于游戏内 1 天。
items.en: Five real minutes roughly equal one in-game day.

items.zh: 一天依次经过上课、午饭、上课、放学后、晚上。
items.en: A day cycles through class, lunch, class, after school, and night.

items.zh: 底部时间条会显示当前学期、日期和一天内的进度。
items.en: The bottom timeline shows the current semester, day, and daily progress.

items.zh: 早上上课时，6 到 8 年级主要前往主教学楼，9 到 12 年级主要前往副教学楼。
items.en: During morning class, grades 6-8 mainly move to the main teaching building, while grades 9-12 mainly move to the secondary teaching building.

items.zh: 午饭时，大多数学生前往食堂，少部分会去小卖铺、操场或宿舍。
items.en: At lunch, most students go to the cafeteria, while some visit the shop, field, or dormitory.

items.zh: 放学后，学生会分布到宿舍楼、操场、网球场、室内体育馆、艺术中心和游乐区。
items.en: After school, students distribute across dorms, the field, tennis court, indoor gym, art center, and play area.

items.zh: 晚上，多数学生回到宿舍楼，少部分仍会留在操场。
items.en: At night, most students return to dorms, while a smaller group remains on the field.

items.zh: 组织成员在小队处于分散状态时，仍然按照普通学生日程行动。
items.en: Organization members still follow normal student schedules while their squad is dispersed.

items.zh: 小队进入集合或潜伏后，成员会脱离普通日程 AI。
items.en: When a squad gathers or goes covert, its members leave the normal schedule AI.

items.zh: 学生日程只在时间段切换时重新分配，不会每帧随机跳动。
items.en: Schedules are reassigned only when the time block changes, not every frame.
